'''Yandel Roe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war he worked as a weapon modifications [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where he ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Yandel Roe had [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin. While at his stall he wore a white and blue uniform.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yandel Roe appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Modification Commendations Vendor for Republic players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Yandel Roe was removed from the game along with the rest of the Modification Commendations Vendors.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
